justification: Image A depicts a grid of carved glyphic blocks arranged in rows and columns, a system of abstract logographic signs with no figural imagery, while Image B depicts a boat-like vessel with a ladder-like row of vertical strokes, flanked by curling prow/stern elements, an animal figure, and vertical linear marks. There is no correspondence in the kinds of elements shown, their relationships, or their arrangement—one is a script-like grid, the other a figurative scene with a boat and animal.
